messages:
tara: Heads-up: while preparing the sample-app SDK release I ran `yarn typegen` and got a regen diff that changed TypeScript overload ordering. Local smoke tests fail. Repro: `git checkout release && yarn && yarn typegen && git diff --name-only`
alex: paste the minimal diff?
tara: here9s the offending snippet:
```diff
- getUsers(ids: string[], opts?: {page?: number, includeInactive?: boolean})
+ getUsers(ids: string[], includeInactive?: boolean, opts?: {page?: number})
```
nina: Oof. That9s a positional break for callers using positional args. Did the OpenAPI schema change?
tara: No schema change in openapi.yaml. Looks like `@redwood/typegen` v0.12.3 produced a different param flattening.
chris: Our changelog automation only saw a tiny comment update in the sample-app repo and auto-labeled as patch. We9re seeing a semantic mismatch between changelog labels and actual signature diffs.
alex: Next steps: block the release, revert any published SDK artifacts for sample-app if already pushed, and treat this as a semver-impact review.
changelog-bot: changelog-bot note: added label "semver:review" to PR #220 (automated rule override requested)
nina: Short-term fix: either patch typegen to preserve previous overload ordering (publish 0.12.4) or revert the SDK artifacts and force a coorded minor if we decide new ordering is intentional.
tara: I9m opening a revert PR now and flagging the changelog entry for manual review: https://git.redwood.ai/p/sample-apps/pulls/220
chris: Also add a regen-diff CI guard that fails if generated TS signatures reorder without a corresponding OpenAPI schema change. That would catch these cases before publish.
alex: And add a unit test in typegen asserting deterministic overload ordering for optional param groups. This has been a repeated CI flake.
nina: Filing follow-ups: 1) regen-diff guard, 2) typegen unit test, 3) changelog-bot rule update (signature diffs -> manual review), 4) postmortem if revert lands.
tara: Gist with reproducer and openapi fragment: https://gist.github.com/tara/regen-repro-214 (includes local `yarn typegen` output)
chris: I'll hold the release until 0.12.4 is published and sample-app smoke tests are green.
tara: Will confirm when smoke is green and changelog has been corrected. :thumbsup:
